description: Designs Claude Code prompts and CC environments. Produces CLAUDE.md drafts, agent topologies, scope-authorization frameworks, halt triggers, Skills/hooks/MCP plans, chat-to-CC handoff specs, and EXECUTION_PLAN.md remediation plans. Five modes: DESIGN (new CC deployments), EVOLVE (updates from friction), RESEARCH (evaluate a CC tool/pattern), TEMPLATE (reusable artifacts), REMEDIATE (consume hygiene findings → produce + execute plan). Use when user says "design CC for X", "build CC environment", "design CLAUDE.md", "build a CC prompt", "design a CC prompt for X", "write a session prompt", "we hit X friction in CC", "should we adopt Y for CC", "give me a CLAUDE.md skeleton", "remediate the hygiene findings". Do NOT use REMEDIATE for direct cleanup (Cat 1–10 — use rootnode-repo-hygiene Phase 2; REMEDIATE handles Cat 11–14 + 7-layer leaks). Do NOT use for hygiene scanning (use rootnode-repo-hygiene). Do NOT use for chat prompts (rootnode-prompt-validation) or chat Projects (rootnode-project-audit).
